basis: M10W14 outcome-blind coverage map only. No trade outcome, PF, PnL, win rate, future path label, or threshold rescue was used to choose these formulas.

common.entry: Exact M1 execution at the next M15 open timestamp. LONG enters at ask=M1 open + spread_points*point; SHORT enters at bid=M1 open.
common.exit: Fixed 240 minutes after entry at exact M1 timestamp. LONG exits bid=M1 open; SHORT exits ask=M1 open + spread_points*point.
common.overlap_rule: Later same-family candidates inside the active 240-minute interval are skipped.
common.reason_no_ATR_filter: Avoid using M10W14 regime density to cherry-pick high/low volatility after seeing coverage. ATR may be reported descriptively only.

BSC1_SHORT_BEAR_TREND_PULLBACK_ZERO_CROS.structural_hypothesis: A missing aligned-bear trend-continuation family may have edge when a lower-timeframe pullback ends inside a fully bearish D1/H4/H1 context.
regime_at_decision: D1 EMA20 < EMA30 < EMA40 using only fully closed D1 bars
H4 EMA20 < EMA30 using only fully closed H4 bars
H1 TORYS MACD line(6,13,4) < 0 using only fully closed H1 bars
BSC1_SHORT_BEAR_TREND_PULLBACK_ZERO_CROS.trigger: On the just-closed M15 bar, TORYS MACD histogram crosses from >0 on the previous closed M15 bar to <=0 on the current closed M15 bar.
BSC1_SHORT_BEAR_TREND_PULLBACK_ZERO_CROS.decision: Next M15 open immediately after the trigger bar closes.

BLC1_LONG_BULL_TREND_PULLBACK_ZERO_CROSS.structural_hypothesis: Symmetric control: an aligned-bull trend-continuation family may have edge when a lower-timeframe pullback ends inside a fully bullish D1/H4/H1 context.
regime_at_decision: D1 EMA20 > EMA30 > EMA40 using only fully closed D1 bars
H4 EMA20 > EMA30 using only fully closed H4 bars
H1 TORYS MACD line(6,13,4) > 0 using only fully closed H1 bars
BLC1_LONG_BULL_TREND_PULLBACK_ZERO_CROSS.trigger: On the just-closed M15 bar, TORYS MACD histogram crosses from <0 on the previous closed M15 bar to >=0 on the current closed M15 bar.
BLC1_LONG_BULL_TREND_PULLBACK_ZERO_CROSS.decision: Next M15 open immediately after the trigger bar closes.

decision_tiers.REJECT: Any split PF <= 1.0 with adequate count, or all-sample fixed0p20 PF <= 1.0, or all-sample extra2bps PF <= 1.0.

frozen_evaluation.fresh_shadow_rule: Only a ROBUST_CANDIDATE or STRONG_CANDIDATE may advance to a new independent fresh prospective shadow. Historical support alone is not final support.
